subject: general
question: Which country has hosted 35th ASEAN Summit in Oct-Nov 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thailand**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 35th summit of the Association of South-East Asian Nations, held in Bangkok.__
 
• The Asian South-East Nations Association(ASEAN) is a regional intergovernmental organization comprising 10 Southeast Asian countries, fostering intergovernmental cooperation and promoting economic, educational, political, security, military, and socio-cultural integration between its members and other Asian nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• ASEAN was followed by an organization established on July 31, 1961, named the Association of Southeast Asia (ASA), a Thai group, the Philippines, and the Malaysian Federation.
 
• It was established on 8 August 1967, when the ASEAN Declaration was signed by the foreign ministers of five countries: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.
 
• It was awarded observer status at the UN General Assembly in 2006.
